propositions: The autouse _no_repo_commits guard invokes git rev-parse HEAD before and after every test, averaging 7.826ms per call on macOS and projecting ~75s wall-time overhead across the full suite.
A per-test checkout HEAD move must be detected and attributed to the responsible test while preserving the allow_repo_writes escape and session-wide dirty-tree backstop.
No consensus-backed, fidelity-preserving implementation primitive exists: adding a Git library adds dependency risk, hand-parsing refs is unsafe, and removing the attribution guard weakens coverage.
Four major active OSS projects (pytest, pip, Poetry, pre-commit) avoid per-test source-checkout Git subprocess calls in their test hot paths, providing directional consensus for eliminating them.
The ticket was blocked pending explicit operator design choice or new evidence for a safe primitive, and ultimately closed wontfix by operator disposition without completion.
